_comment: External MCP servers for Weebot. Loaded when WEEBOT_ENABLE_X_MCP=1 and MCP_SERVERS_CONFIG_PATH points here. Dollar-brace variable references come from .env; an unset one stops start-up (fail closed), and that includes any written inside these comments. Tools arrive as mcp__<server>__<tool>: their output is untrusted, and publish/send/delete/generate tools always ask (WEEBOT_OUTBOUND_TOOL_PATTERNS).

postiz._comment: Self-hosted Postiz (~/postiz/compose, docker compose). API key: Postiz UI > Settings > Public API.
